content:
sarah.ng: Heads-up — perm chooser is super slow for tenants with >10k roles. Repro on staging when opening the role selector on route edit.
kevin.h: repro'd locally, saw ~1.2s API response and ~900ms render on the client.
lina.t: do you have a HAR or sample payload? sounds like client virtualization might help but 1.2s backend is the root cause.
sarah.ng: attaching sample payload size (trimmed):
```
GET /api/v1/tenants/tn-123/roles?query=&limit=100
200 OK
Content-Length: 987654
roles: [ {id: "r_1", name: "Admin/Full Access"}, {id: "r_2", name: "Billing - viewer"}, ... ]
```
kevin.h: payload is big — almost a meg. We're returning full role metadata + policy blobs for every role. We should switch to lightweight role stubs for the chooser.
lina.t: agreed. Two options: (A) server-side pagination + client virtualization + search-as-you-type; (B) keep full list but add tenant-level caching + gzipped transport. (A) is better for scale.
jules-pm: from PM side, we need behavior parity for enterprise customers used to seeing full list; can't break bulk-export workflows. But for the selector UX, partial results + "show more" is acceptable. We should do a dark-launch canary.
sarah.ng: proposal: update /v1/roles?summary=true to return stubs (id, name, tags) and a separate endpoint /v1/roles/:id for full metadata. Add header X-List-Mode: summary|full for backward compat.
kevin.h: prefer cursor pagination to offset. API example: `GET /v1/roles?limit=100&cursor=eyJvIjoi...` -> returns next_cursor. That plus `summary=true` will keep payloads tiny.
lina.t: client-side: implement react-virtualized list + debounce search 200ms, and only call API when query length >= 2 or when arrow-navigating. Also show inline loading rows.
sarah.ng: telemetry: we need a new trace/metric: `perm_chooser.api_latency_ms`, `perm_chooser.render_ms`, `perm_chooser.payload_bytes`, and a tag for `tenant_size=small|medium|large`. We'll roll this to datadog.
jules-pm: add experiment flags: feature flag `perm_chooser_v2` for 10% -> 50% -> 100% ramp, measure 95th pct render latency and task completion (did user select role within 5s).
deploy-bot: deploy started: frontend/perm-chooser v2 -> canary at 10% (deploy id: deploy-2026-03-20-77).
kevin.h: one more internal API debate: do we change the canonical role list endpoint name? Breaking change worries. Proposal: keep `/v1/roles` but accept `?view=summary` and return `X-List-Mode` in response headers. No new route.
lina.t: fine. We'll implement server-side search + cursor + summary view. For VIP tenants we can have `full=true` with authorization.
sarah.ng: edge-case: what about routes that rely on role `description` sorting? summary won't include description. We can add `meta` minimal sortable fields.
jules-pm: UX copy: when results are partial show "Showing top results — refine search or click show more". Product ok with that.
kevin.h: action items: (1) API PR: summary view + cursor pagination (owner: kevin) — target EOD Thu. (2) Frontend PR: virtualization + debounce (owner: lina) — target Mon. (3) Telemetry dashboard + SLO: (owner: sarah) — target next Wed. (4) Canary plan: jules to own rollout.
sarah.ng: I'll create the RFC/notes in the platform docs and tag eng-sre for cache/infra concerns.
jules-pm: can we add a metric for "selector-abandon-rate"? i.e., opened selector and closed without choosing within 10s. helps measure regressions.
kevin.h: good idea. We'll emit an event for open/close/select with timestamps.
lina.t: quick perf trick: server can return `X-Approx-Count` header so client can show "~12k roles" without loading all. cheap and UX-friendly.
sarah.ng: agreed.
jules-pm: timeline looks good. let's sync in 30m in #eng-platform if any blockers. :thumbsup:
kevin.h: noted, starting API branch now.
deploy-bot: canary complete: frontend/perm-chooser v2 -> 10% stable. monitoring dashboards: perm_chooser.* active.
kevin.h: preliminary numbers: api_latency down from 1200ms -> 180ms in summary mode on staging. good signal.
lina.t: client render 95th went 900ms -> 220ms with virtualization.
sarah.ng: awesome. closing thread, will paste RFC link when ready.
